entities.summary: Myron Jackson is a retired American professional basketball player who played briefly in the National Basketball Association (NBA). Born in Hamburg, Arkansas, he was a 6-foot-3-inch (191 cm), 185-pound (84 kg) point guard and played collegiately at University of Arkansas at Little Rock.
